snippet.title: Elias the Mighty
snippet.description:
Join legendary Russian folk hero, Elias the Mighty, in a thrilling Arcade Puzzle game based on shape recognition. Match objects with corresponding shapes to keep Elias and fellow characters strong. Fight alongside Elias the Mighty in a classic storyline.

http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/3391/elias-the-mighty-game/index.html
